test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which is Satyajit Ray's famous film about the decline of the aristocratic zamindari style of living?
solution:
The correct answer is __Jalsaghar__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jalsaghar** (aka "The Music Room") is a 1958 drama film directed by master Indian filmmaker Satyajit Ray.
 
• Based on a short story of the same name by Bangla writer Tarashankar Bandopadhyay, Jalsaghar presents the tale of the **decline of a feudal lord in pre-independence India.**
 
• Film series: The Apu Series
 
• Actor: Chhabi Biswas
 
• Story by: Tarasankar Bandyopadhyay
